targets.title: Objects don’t object: Evidence that self-objectification disrupts women’s social activism
targets.evidence_quote: Here, we report two preregistered direct replications (PDRs) of Calogero’s original study.
targets.outcome_quote: In 2013, Calogero found a negative link between self-objectification and collective action, which was mediated by the adoption of gender-specific system justification. Here, we report two preregistered direct replications (PDRs) of Calogero’s original study. We conducted these PDRs after three failures to replicate the positive relation between self-objectification and gender-specific system-justification belief in correlational studies. Results of the two PDRs, in which we used a Bayesian approach, supported the null hypothesis.
targets.outcome_reasoning: The two replications support the null against the original association; the discussion also states that the whole model was not replicated.
